narratives.Overview:
## Leftover of #167 / Phase 6 Step 2

Recurrence: 2026-09-20 through-merge collection. Product PRs used Tracking/Refs, never Closes. Leftover PR #4823 moved twelve xBRIEFs active/ to completed/ on master. GitHub issues stayed open. Operator caught #4813 still open; REST then closed #4780 #4782 #4783 #4793 #4794 #4795 #4796 #4798 #4801 #4813 #4129 #4163. #4781 stayed open (parked, no PR).

## What is broken

Tracking/Refs is the through-merge standing (Layer 3 / #701: Closes on squash will shut a linked issue even when not intended). GitHub will not auto-close on Tracking. Closing is Phase 6 Step 2: after merge, REST-check state and, if still open, close with a comment naming the PR.

That step was skipped because leftover-complete of xBRIEFs was treated as the closeout unit.

Two existing gates look at GitHub closed, not the inverse:

- verify:orphan-active fails when the issue is closed and the brief is still in active/.
- verify:completed-tracked fails when a closed issue has no completed/ artifact.

A completed brief whose origin is still open is green on both.

swarm:finalize-cohort --pr binds delivery evidence from GraphQL closingIssuesReferences. Tracking never fills that list, so the same miss also forced --merge-commit by hand and never closed the issue.

#167 already covers squash plus closing keywords silently failing to close. This leftover is the Tracking path: close was never attempted.

## Recut

After finalize-cohort lands (or after pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge when the PR body is Tracking/Refs), REST-check each origin issue (repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<N>). If it is still open and not a protected staying-OPEN umbrella, either:

- close with Completed in #<PR> (Phase 6 Step 2), or
- fail-closed verify:origin-closed (or an origin-open-after-complete check on the finalize dest).

Keep Tracking/Refs on through-merge. Do not teach Closes. Do not use gh issue view --json.

## Fences

- Do not recut Layer 3 / #701 Closes-on-squash.
- Do not treat umbrellas / staying-OPEN protected issues as this close.
- Do not merge this into #4821 dest-worker skip or #4822 wait-verb swallow.
- Parked stories with no merged PR (#4781) stay open.

Refs #167 #4823 #701 #3153 #3476

Refutation-target under test: leftover-complete of xBRIEFs (active to completed on master) is sufficient closeout after Tracking/Refs merge, so origin GitHub issues may stay open.

The presumption is false as a closeout unit. leftover-complete is sufficient for verify:completed-tracked (#3476) and not for GitHub origin close. Pin-read at a4bb0675fc00a619b03a35abb2cdb38927bb3da7: Grok leftover owner names leftover-complete / completed-tracked as Phase 6 swarm:finalize-cohort and does not name Step 2. evaluateCompletedTracked skips state === "open". Recurrence timestamps: product PR 4815 merged 2026-09-20T14:06:14Z with body Tracking #4813 (no Closes); leftover PR 4823 merged 17:29:14Z as a4bb0675 (twelve xBRIEFs, test plan named verify:completed-tracked only); #4813 REST-closed 17:35:32Z by comment 5751460398 after that land. The recut as written still cannot bind.

## Wait-merge origin-close contradicts orphan-active — blocks-the-design

Evidence. Issue recut: After finalize-cohort lands (or after pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge when the PR body is Tracking/Refs). Existing Step 2 already says close after each squash merge (gh issue view --json state) and again for each completed xBRIEF. Envelope SLA after merge: verify:orphan-active -- --issue N must exit 0 before DONE; ISSUE: closed while the brief is still in active/ is forbidden. assessOrphanSignature ships (fail) when the selected origin is closed on an active/running brief. #4813 stayed in that window for ~3h after 4815 merged and ~6min after 4823 landed. Grok leftover is finalize-cohort after wait-merge, not at wait-merge.

Failure mode. Binding the wait-merge arm closes origins while xBRIEFs remain in active/. That fail-closes orphan-active (#2321 / #3429) and reddens later merge-chokepoint scans that own those briefs. Layer 3 / #701 is the opposite polarity (reopen protected issues after squash). Tracking/Refs is standing so GitHub will not auto-close at wait-merge; that gap is closed by leftover-complete then origin-close, not by moving close earlier.

Disposition. A successor lean cannot keep wait-merge as a close trigger. Origin-close is after leftover-complete land of those stories (finalize-cohort or scope:complete plus verify:completed-tracked green on origin/<deliveryBranch>), then REST-check those origins.

## Origin denominator is leftover --stories, not closingIssuesReferences — sharpens-framing

Evidence. fetchClosingIssuesReferences (packages/core/src/pr-protected-issues/gh.ts) runs gh pr view --json closingIssuesReferences (GraphQL). Tracking never fills that list; that is #2230. finalize-cohort --pr then errors empty cohort: pass --pr and/or --stories unless --stories is supplied. Recurrence used --stories / --merge-commit; leftover PR 4823 body also did not Closes the twelve. Unscoped inverse on task check would fail every completed brief whose origin is intentionally open (umbrellas, standing-open trackers). REST confirmed #4781 still open (parked, no PR). Step 2 already has close with Completed in #<PR>; leftover-complete skipped it because the leftover owner named completed-tracked as the unit.

Failure mode. Growing fetchClosingIssues to scrape Tracking/Refs from product PR bodies reopens the #2230 false-sweep class. An unscoped verify:origin-closed on task check false-fails protected staying-OPEN issues. More Step 2 English without a per-cohort gate is the #167 class (prose that was skipped). Silent auto-close inside finalize races Layer 3 reopen and is a GitHub write under requireHumanMerge.

Disposition. Bound-remedy: after leftover-complete of the named story list, fail-closed REST GET repos/<owner>/<repo>/issues/<N> for those completed briefs github-issue refs only; if still open and not a protected staying-OPEN umbrella and not parked-with-no-merged-PR, close with a comment naming the product PR, or refuse DONE. Keep Tracking/Refs. Do not teach Closes. Do not use gh issue view --json. Do not recut Layer 3 / #701. Do not merge this into #4821 or #4822. REST rewrite of Step 2 GraphQL line is hygiene, not the gate.

## Injection / swarm

This target changes close authority, untrusted forge input, leftover concurrency, and shared GitHub/xBRIEF state. Origin list is the same --stories / completed-brief refs leftover-complete already trusted; do not concatenate Tracking/Refs tokens from product bodies. Prefer a fail-closed verifier that names REST PATCH over silent auto-close in finalize. Close only after active/ is empty for those origins so orphan-active stays green. Process-only; no dest occupy, no ingest, no labels.

## Road-not-taken

Closes on leftover PR 4823 would fire at the safe time (after complete). Rejected: #167 squash can silently fail to close, and #701 persistent closingIssuesReferences can shut umbrellas. Steelman of the wait-merge arm: leftover-complete can be skipped, so close at product merge. What would flip that verdict is a leftover owner that cannot DONE without origin-close after land. Moving close earlier flips orphan-active red instead.

## footnote

#167 (closed 2026-04-06) is squash plus closing keywords silently failing, plus ROADMAP. ROADMAP leftover is already #4316 (off leftover-complete). This leftover is the Tracking path: close was never attempted. Pin Step 2 still documents gh issue view --json state; the recut already forbids that (#954). Not P1 relief.
